seo.title: Websites for Restaurants | SynergyFirst Digital
seo.metaDescription: Managed websites for restaurants and hospitality businesses — menus, hours and reservations front and center, built mobile-first.
seo.ogDescription: Make it effortless for hungry customers to find your menu, hours and table.

h1: Make it effortless to find your menu, hours and table.

sections.subheading: Most diners decide where to eat from their phone, in under a minute. Your website needs to answer the three questions that matter — what, when and how to book — instantly.

sections.heading: Problems we see most often
sections.intro: Common reasons a restaurant website loses diners it should be winning.

items.title: Menu buried in a PDF
items.body: Or missing entirely — a hungry customer won't dig for it and will move on.

items.title: Hours and location hard to find
items.body: Especially on mobile, where most restaurant searches happen.

items.title: No clear path to book or order
items.body: Reservation and ordering links aren't obvious or aren't linked at all.

items.title: Photos that undersell the experience
items.body: Low-quality or outdated photography doesn't reflect the food or atmosphere.

sections.heading: How we build your preview
sections.intro: The same free-preview process, shaped around a restaurant.

steps.title: Apply
steps.body: Tell us about your restaurant, cuisine and what's not working on your current site (or that you don't have one).

steps.title: We build your preview
steps.body: A private concept site with your menu, hours and booking links front and center.

steps.title: Review for 7 days
steps.body: Explore it privately and tell us what to change. No cost, no obligation.

steps.title: Activate and launch
steps.body: Like it? Choose a plan and we finish, connect your domain, and launch it.

sections.heading: Built for how diners choose a restaurant

items.title: Menu front and center
items.body: Easy to browse, and easy for you to update when dishes or prices change.

items.title: Hours, location and map
items.body: Clearly displayed, with directions one tap away.

items.title: Reservation & ordering links
items.body: Integrated with the booking and delivery platforms you already use.

items.title: Photography-led, mobile-first design
items.body: Fast-loading pages that do your food justice on any device.

sections.heading: See what a restaurant website preview looks like.
sections.body: Apply for a complimentary preview — most restaurants start on our Website Essential or Website Growth plan depending on whether ongoing marketing support is needed, and we'll confirm the right fit for you.
